daily_drilling_reports.description: Observed erratic torque spikes (24-28 kft-lbs) at 1,420 m MD. Back-reamed and adjusted mud flow to 3,200 lpm.

daily_drilling_reports.activity: Drilling 12-1/4 in section in Hordaland shale
daily_drilling_reports.description: Partial mud loss of 35 m3/hr encountered at 2,780 m MD. Pumped 15 m3 LCM pill (calcium carbonate + mica). Restored full circulation after 8 hrs NPT.
Gas influx detected at 3,410 m MD (gain 2.8 m3). Shut in well on BOP, recorded SIDPP 32 bar. Killed well using 1.45 SG heavy mud.
Overpull of 45 tons experienced while tripping out at 1,850 m. Worked pipe and performed wiper trip.
Casing wear log indicated 14% wall thickness reduction near dogleg severity zone at 3,200 m.
Severe mud loss (48 m3/hr) at 2,450 m MD. Mixed and spotted 20 m3 high-reactivity LCM. Well stabilized.
Continuous stick-slip and severe torque fluctuations (up to 32 kft-lbs). Replaced BHA bit with PDC cutter optimized for abrasive sandstone.
